name: Illuminated Folio
desc: A medieval manuscript page assembling itself: a block of gothic textura writes in line by line, a historiated drop-cap sits in its jewelled ground, and a gilt vine grows down the margin sprouting leaves, buds and burnished bezants while a shaft of light rakes the page so the gold leaf flares as it passes. When the folio is complete it turns and a fresh page in new colours begins. Gilt-and-lapis, azure-dominant, austere red-and-black rubric, or a cyan blueprint negative.

energy.doc: ink and gild contrast and raking-light glow

scale.doc: drop-cap and text size -- larger hand, fewer lines (obvious change)

speed.doc: writing / vine-growth rate and how often the folio turns

gild.doc: amount of gold and how strongly it flares under the light

hue.doc: vellum tone for the default; other styles fix their own

style.doc: aesthetic: gilt-and-lapis / azure-dominant / austere red-and-black rubric / cyan blueprint negative

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-throws the initial letter, text, vine and vellum toning
